title: The uniform residual margin implies the profile ceiling

ceiling.inputs: The selected shell has r_(N,k)>=sqrt(3)/4 and residual admissibility has t_(N,k)=eta rho_(N,k)r_(N,k)<=1-epsilon.
ceiling.bound: Every nonnegative profile entry satisfies rho_(N,k)<=4(1-epsilon)/(eta sqrt(3)), uniformly in N.
ceiling.consequence: For fixed eta and epsilon, K1671--K1673 need no separate bounded-profile assumption beyond the declared uniform residual margin.
ceiling.scope_guard: A vanishing margin, N-dependent eta, unknown coefficient family or different covariance shell is not covered.
